What was the last romance movie you watched, if you don't mind me asking?
I love 'How to Lose a Guy in 10 days' because Matthew McConaughey & Kate Hudson are such a perfect match and I find it to be so relatable. Its my favorite so I keep watching it over and over!
I'll have to check that one out, I don't think I've ever seen it.
Oh its definitely worth the watch! Just the right about of comedy but the chemistry is what keeps me watching it :)
Having the right amount of comedy and chemistry is what makes a great romantic comedy! I'll trust you with this one.! I'll watch it soon!
Well awesome :) Sounds good! I hope you enjoy!
Thank you!
Were you interested in looking into any other movies?

Always. I'm a huge fan of action packed movies..I just recently went and saw Bad Boys for Life starring Will Smith and Martin Lawrence. And I really enjoy horror movies, but I haven't seen on in a while..
